notes: The base profile has OpenCL compute records but no standalone stage records, so disk reload, transfer and transform used optimistic fallbacks.
On trace28, online CP selected disk_gpu for all disk weights and was much slower than diff-tree/current-base plans that used more disk_cpu and avoided transfer.
This calibration makes disk_gpu reload/prepare more expensive for 14B Q4 pressure planning while keeping CPU-resident and GPU-resident compute unchanged.
